title: confiture seed generate --format json
description: Result of writing a commented-out INSERT stub for one table (SeedGenerationResult.to_dict). A stub the command declined to write (the table is not found or has no columns, the file exists without --overwrite, the introspection query failed) is this shape with success false and error set, and exits 1; a failure outside generation writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

table.description: The table named on the command line, as given (unqualified; --schema names its schema).

output_path.description: The stub file, <output-dir>/<seed-env>/<table>.sql: written, already present, or — when the table could not be read — where it would have been written, and no file is.

row_count.description: Stub rows written (--rows); 0 when no stub was written.

column_count.description: Columns the table has; 0 when the table could not be read.

success.description: True when the stub was written.

error.description: Why no stub was written; null on success.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
